purpose: Crop- and ZARC-window-conditioned derived water transitions for transparent Monte Carlo scenarios.

source.climate: NASA POWER daily normalized profile; ET0 computed using FAO-56 Penman–Monteith with documented Hargreaves fallback
source.soil: SoilGrids mean prediction; AWC derived using Saxton–Rawls, 0–100 cm
source.crop_water: FAO-56 Table 11–12 Kc and stage-day references
source.planting_eligibility: MAPA SISZARC public report rows for the profile municipality; model scenarios emitted only for a nonzero 20/30/40 risk decendio in at least one selected group/soil row
source.pseudocount: 0.5 per observed viable next-state destination at Monte Carlo load time; not part of the historical counts

parameter_reference.reference_context: Duração de 125 dias em região tropical úmida (exemplo FAO-56 Table 11); Kc_ini herdado do cabeçalho de cereais, Kc_end=0.35 para grão seco no campo (nota 11 da Table 12).

off_crop_demand.status: reference ET0 demand; no cover/fallow crop observed

Outside the crop cycle the bucket uses the Kc=1 reference demand; it does not represent measured bare soil or an unmeasured cover crop.
Water transitions do not predict yield, revenue, soil-health change, or economic return.
